synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO treats the median probability-of-exceedance as the most likely regional demand and produces pre-dispatch forecasts at half-hourly resolution.

document_statements.quote: In accordance with NER 4.9.1 AEMO must produce the most probable (50% probability of exceedance) energy demand for each region for each 30-minute period.
The 50% POE forecast is used to set generation targets in pre-dispatch.
This includes forecasts for each trading interval of the initial 60-minute period following publication, and forecasts for each subsequent 30-minute period of the pre-dispatch schedule.
Pre-dispatch has a 30-minute resolution and forecasts up to 40 hours ahead.
